rationale: The workflow already implements several evidence-supported optimizations: dependency and build caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE), superseded run cancellation (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE), and custom job timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT). Remaining patterns from the catalogue either have contraindications for this workflow (e.g., P-LIT-FAIL-FAST may hide required matrix diagnostics; P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST would require serializing independent jobs and lacks failure-rate data), lack repository-specific evidence (e.g., adjusting timeout values via P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT needs representative per-job history), or are not applicable (e.g., scheduled workflow patterns). No optimization with clear, safe, and measured benefit for this specific workflow is identified in the provided evidence.
